dependency_62444.scope: CPU offload LRU refresh; no FP8 projection change

native_flag_status: requested name for native port; current tested plugin still uses ATOM flags
overlap: AITER FlyDSL FP8 FMHA with dynamic per-tensor Q/K/V quantization
distinct_current_integration: vLLM native online FP8 kv_b_proj weights into unchanged AITER gather_kv_b_proj_flydsl; direct FP8 K/V stores consumed by FMHA
pr_weight_precision_caveat: Neither PR selects kv_b_proj weight quantization or adds the direct FP8-cache x FP8-weight -> FP8-K/V fusion. Existing model/config may independently use FP8 projection weights.
kernel_origin: Projection and FMHA kernels are existing AITER kernels, not newly invented kernels.
numerical_comparison: Different scaling/routing policies and different tests; no claim of byte-identical numerics or direct performance ranking.
